description: Perpetual-futures order books for one asset across OKX, Hyperliquid, dYdX and Kraken Futures, side by side and merged: per-venue best bid/ask and spread, depth and bid/ask imbalance within ±0.5%, ±1% and ±2% of each venue's mid (in quote value), the cross-venue best bid/ask and any crossed books between venues, and the top merged levels. Accepts BTC, BTCUSDT, BTC/USDT, BTC-USDT-SWAP or Kraken's XBT. Depth bands that extend past what a venue returns are flagged as lower bounds. Venues that fail are listed under errors; the call fails (and is not charged) only if none answers. Costs $0.005 USDC per call.

levels.description: Price levels to show per venue and in the merged book, 1–50 (default 10)

name: order_book_aggregator
